title: RingedIdealGenerators
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Represent an ideal subsheaf by a monomorphism $\iota:\mathcal I\to\mathcal O$ of module sheaves. Use covering sieves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. A finite list $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in\mathcal O(U)$ generates $\mathcal I|_U$ if, for every $a:V\to U$ and $x\in\mathcal O(V)$, $x$ belongs to $\mathcal I(V)$ exactly when there is a covering sieve $S$ of $V$ such that, for every $b:W\to V$ in $S$, $x|_W$ belongs to the ideal spanned by the $f_i|_W$. This specified-list predicate is expressed using Mathlib’s GeneratingSections on the slice, matching the images of the generating sections at its terminal object with the prescribed ring sections. Empty lists are allowed. Local finite generation itself uses the existing SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType class of [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation].
